findings.issue: PR targets AdicSpaces Layer 3.3 (`𝒪_X(U) = A_U` on the rational basis, values in `CompleteSeparatedTopCommRingCat`), but Layer 3.1 is only half built. Roadmap README.md:473-479 also requires `A_U⁺` as an integral closure, that `(A_U, A_U⁺)` is a Huber pair with `Spa` homeomorphic to `U`, the canonical isomorphism between two presentations of the same rational subset, three-presentation compatibility, and the restriction maps. Nothing under `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/**` or `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace/**` supplies any of these, and the author states (last round) no open PR does either. The object built here is explicitly presentationwise, i.e. it is not yet a function of `R(T/s)` — precisely the gap the missing 3.1 stage closes.

summary: The cited target (Layer 3.3, presheaf codomain) presupposes the rest of Layer 3.1 — A_U⁺, the Huber pair (A_U, A_U⁺), presentation-independence and restriction maps — none of which exist on main or in a linked open PR; the author withdrew their contest on this point in the last round and agreed the PR should be parked. Single-topic is fine.
